scope: First general workstation Agent implementation; basic acceptance and handoff for owner testing.
features: Workspace file listing, UTF-8 reading/searching, creation, version-checked replacement/editing, copy/move/delete and directory creation
PowerShell/CMD/sh execution, bounded output, background process status/input/stop, timeout and task cancellation
Task-owned Chromium browser DOM observation, filling/clicking/selecting/keys/scrolling/navigation/upload and PNG screenshots
Windows window/accessibility observation, text-editor readback, focus/mouse/Unicode typing/hotkeys/scrolling/InvokePattern/ValuePattern and PNG screenshots
Owner settings for workspace and desktop/browser access; task-captured permissions and durable no-replay operation receipts

validation.targeted_existing_and_new_backend_tests: 145 passed, followed by the additional Windows desktop test passing; 146 distinct tests overall
basic_actual_operations: Actual command output/nonzero exit, timeout, background termination and operation replay rejection
Actual Windows accessibility set-value and SendInput hotkeys/Chinese typing with text readback
validation.task_integration: Real encrypted state + consumer tool registry + approval + actual file creation/readback + verification; model boundary is a deterministic API fixture
validation.packaged_backend: Isolated node startup; all 40 business tools registered; new settings saved and read back

limits: Model observes DOM/accessibility text; screenshot pixels are saved but not sent as vision input
Windows desktop only; custom drawn or elevated/secure windows may be inaccessible
Browser uses a separate profile and does not inherit owner browser logins
Browser/background process lifetime is bounded to at most 600 seconds; processes and browser sessions are not reconstructed after backend restart
Workspace path restrictions apply to file tools; shell execution is not an OS sandbox
UTF-8 file helpers are limited to 1 MiB and bounded text pages; larger/binary data requires command-line tools
No new MCP/plugin ecosystem, Office skill collection or subagent framework in this first batch
True model-directed task quality and installed-app usability are pending owner manual testing
